online_coverage.explanation: Feature coverage is fully covered / total. Weighted coverage is the mean per-feature completion ratio so partial gold steps count.

offline_coverage.explanation: Offline coverage is an LLM/VLM semantic judge vs ground-truth JSON. Feature Coverage = COVERED / Total. Weighted Coverage = mean(completion_ratio) so partial gold steps still count. Step order is not required. Later exploration can complete an earlier partial feature.
